storylines.text: Kyle Schwarber is running hot right now, hitting well above his 0.241 season average over his last games with at least one home run in that stretch. He faces NYY sends out Ryan Weathers today, in a park that plays up for power, a pitcher who's allowed a 0.254 average against this season.

Byron Buxton is in a real home run drought — none in his last 10 games — but the underlying indicators haven't cooled the same way: a .247 ISO and a 0.893 OPS this season say the power is still there, it just hasn't landed yet. ATH sends out Mason Barnett today.
